title: Bad Cat, the AI sitcom that got people watching
title_candidates: The AI sitcom that already has four episodes and a real fanbase
How one creator made a full AI sitcom called Bad Cat with no cast or crew
The show that looks like it has a real cast but every scene was generated by AI
What happens when one person can make a full TV series with AI and no budget
Bad Cat is an AI sitcom and people are already waiting for the next episode
caption:
Bad Cat is an AI-generated sitcom four episodes in, made by one creator, Daria Zabnieva, using AI video tools. No studio, no cast, no crew.

A few months ago this level of quality was not possible for one person working alone. Now someone with an idea and the right tools can release episodes on a schedule and build a following who actually want more.

When making a show costs almost nothing, the only limit is the idea.
